comment: I took LAIS 308. Sometimes the lectures could be a bit dry, but the films she chose and the lectures were very informative. Learned a lot about culture/history in the hispanic world. The tests/quizzes/homework are not difficult.

I took LAIS 308 - this was not listed as an option to select here. She was very chill and an easy grader. Participation is important but she rarely cold calls, except for grammar questions with quick answers. Be prepared to watch a movie every week, but other than that, the homework is not extensive.

I had Professor Fernandez for 221(not on Rate My Professor yet); she was amazing. Though the course is naturally content-heavy, she makes it manageable by only assigning useful homework and offering tons of practice in class.
She's a great profesor who cares about her students. Easy class if you put in effort and she gives lots of extra credit opportunities.

Took for a 308 film class this semester. Had a great time. Only complaint is some of the movies she picked were difficult to understand for a 300 class. Very simple to understand grading structure and very easy to get along with.

Kind, clear, and fun professor. The class itself is a lot (5x a week, constant workflow), but Dr. Fernandez makes the material/expectations easy to understand, and tries her best to make the lessons engaging. You will participate in class. Your knowledge and grade will pretty much reflect how much work you put into this class.

Amazing, understanding professor that truly cares about her students. Offered extra credit when the class was falling behind, and is accommodating to peoples schedules. In class is easy, but alot of studying is needed for quizes and tests. She gives pop quizes once a week, but will offer an ec prob on each one. Meeting with her will go a long way.
